pages.title: Governor
pages.text: Two brass balls on a spinning shaft: run too fast and they swing out and close the throttle, too slow and they fall and open it. Set against a machine with a console, it holds the machine working, near its best, whatever it runs. Needs 32 FE a tick. Made by crafting.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stability.
